description: Precios Marginales Locales de Energía, Mercado de Día en Adelanto, Sistema Interconectado Baja California, 2021 is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Centro Nacional de Control de Energía (CENACE). Muestra información de los Precios Marginales Locales (PML) para el Mercado de Día en Adelanto (MDA) para el Sistema Interconectado Baja California en 2021. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Centro Nacional de Control de Energía (CENACE). Its tags are abastecimiento energía, consumo energía, demanda energética, distribución eléctrica, electricidad. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-02-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
